title: FOMC communications blackout begins (through 2028-01-27) — the window around the January 25-26, 2028 organizational meeting
source: EST: READ OFF THE BOARD'S OWN SHADING, not derived from the rule and not inherited from a sibling's decode. federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/files/fomc-blackout-period-calendar.pdf, fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 98,013 bytes, 'FOMC Blackout Period Calendar', PDF creation stamp D:20250904), carries a JANUARY 2028 page even though the document is titled '2025-2027 FOMC Trading and External Communications Blackout Calendar'. This session inflated that page's content stream and decoded its filled rectangles against the mini-calendar's cell geometry (7 columns at 21.84pt from x=56.52; 2028-01-01 falls in the Saturday column, which is independently correct): the grey 'Blackout dates' fills cover 2028-01-15 through 2028-01-27 inclusive, and the red 'FOMC meeting days' box encloses exactly 2028-01-25 and 2028-01-26. CORROBORATED BY THE POLICY TEXT ON THE SAME PAGE, quoted verbatim from the decoded stream: 'The blackout period will begin at 12:00 a.m. Eastern Time the second Saturday before a meeting and end at 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time the day after a meeting. For example, if the Committee meeting starts on a Tuesday, the blackout period will begin at the start of the Saturday that falls ten days earlier, and if the meeting ends on a Wednesday, the blackout period will end at the end of Thursday.' A Tuesday 2028-01-25 start puts the second preceding Saturday at 2028-01-15 and a Wednesday 2028-01-26 end puts the close at Thursday 2028-01-27 -- the shading and the rule agree cell for cell. Filed estimate on two counts, neither of them date doubt: the meeting it brackets is itself estimate (federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm: 'Each meeting date is tentative until confirmed at the meeting immediately preceding it'), and this lane does not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep. Checked 2026-09-09
notes: PROPOSED by the fomc-2028-01-26 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-09), at D-11 from that decision. Every sibling blackout entry in this calendar was derived from the stated second-Saturday rule and validated against a decode of the PDF's 2025-2027 pages; THIS ONE IS READ DIRECTLY OFF A 2028 PAGE THAT THE PDF ALREADY CONTAINS, which is why it is proposed at all -- the calendar carries zero 2028 entries other than the meeting itself, and the Board has already published this window. The blackout is a communications constraint on Committee participants and System staff, not a market event: it gates Fed speakers, which is the only channel by which it touches the tape at all. NOTHING TRADEABLE IS CLAIMED and the impact tier is inherited, not measured: medium matches every other fomc-blackout-start-* entry. symbols is empty and no house playbook (S1/S2/E1/S3/S4 + G1) is rates-keyed. Proposed as an estimate; estimate widens caution and licenses no entry.
